summary: Build a simple app to generate complete product files (PDFs and downloadable assets) for three digital AI-automation products, suitable for uploading to Gumroad or Etsy.
architectural_notes: Simple app that outputs PDFs and packaged downloadable assets intended for Gumroad/Etsy distribution.
Product themes selected for the three digital products: (1) Digital Planners, (2) Canva Templates (social/business/branding bundles), (3) Printable Wall Art (high-volume Etsy style).
known_issues: Instructions view is not scrollable; users cannot scroll to see the full instructions list.
Instructions popup/modal is still not scrollable on tablet devices; user cannot scroll to see full instructions.
Deployment/build is failing (deployment error); may be transient in the current environment.

existing_features.title: Create a frontend workflow to define and manage three digital product entries (title, subtitle, description, included modules/chapters, prompts/templates/checklists, and optional branding fields), with an editor UI that supports saving drafts locally and regenerating outputs on demand.

Generate complete product files for each of the three products as downloadable assets, including at minimum: (1) a multi-page PDF document and (2) a structured bundle of supplementary files (e.g., TXT/MD templates, checklists, prompt packs) packaged into a single ZIP per product.

Provide a “Gumroad/Etsy export” screen that summarizes the generated deliverables for each product (what’s included, file sizes, and a preview thumbnail), and offers one-click download per product plus a “Download all products” option that creates a single ZIP containing all three product ZIPs.

Add a lightweight backend canister API to store/retrieve product definitions and generation metadata (e.g., last generated time, version tag) so the app can persist product content beyond the browser and support multi-device use with Internet Identity login.

Apply a coherent, distinctive visual theme across the app (colors, typography, spacing, and component styling) appropriate for a “digital product generator” tool, and keep all user-facing text in English.
Add in-app previews: a quick PDF preview (first pages or a rendered preview panel) and a ZIP content preview (tree/list of files that will be included) before downloading.
Include static generated brand/cover imagery for the three products (one cover image per product) as part of the downloadable bundle, and render these images in the UI as preview thumbnails.

Add an in-app, step-by-step instructions section (English) that explains how to use the app end-to-end (edit products, generate bundles, preview, and download), and how to upload the generated files to Gumroad and to Etsy.

Include the same step-by-step usage + Gumroad/Etsy upload instructions inside the generated downloadable documentation by expanding the README content produced for each product ZIP and the master all-products ZIP.
Add a first-launch onboarding modal that automatically opens the first time a user opens the app in a given browser and presents the app usage + Gumroad/Etsy upload instructions inside the app.

Ensure the onboarding modal does not block required first-time profile setup: if the profile setup dialog is shown (authenticated user with no profile), show profile setup first; only show the onboarding modal after profile setup is complete or if profile setup is not needed.
Provide a persistent way for users to re-open the onboarding instructions modal after dismissing it (for example, a header link/button labeled "Instructions" or "Help").
Add a quick-access, always-visible header button labeled "Export" that takes the user to the existing Export screen for downloading generated product files.
Wire the new header "Export" button into the existing view state so it correctly switches between editor and export views while preserving the currently generated bundles in memory.
Fix the Instructions UI so users can scroll to view the full instructions content in all places it is shown (the onboarding instructions modal and the Export screen instructions section).

Fix the onboarding Instructions popup (OnboardingInstructionsModal) so the full instructions content is scrollable on tablet browsers using touch scrolling (e.g., iPad/Android tablets), including when switching between the App Usage / Gumroad / Etsy tabs.

Ensure the Export screen’s embedded instructions section is also reliably scrollable on tablet devices (touch scrolling) without trapping scroll or preventing users from reaching all instruction content.

Update the onboarding instructions modal so the popup (dialog) resizes responsively to fit different screen sizes (phone/tablet/desktop), using responsive Tailwind classes on the existing DialogContent wrapper in frontend/src/components/onboarding/OnboardingInstructionsModal.tsx.

Add a subtle fade-in animation to the onboarding instructions modal content so the dialog smoothly appears when opened (with a short duration and minimal motion), and ensure the animation is disabled when the user has prefers-reduced-motion enabled.

Replace the current default three products with the three highest-profit themes (Digital Planner, Canva Templates, Printable Wall Art) and prefill each product with complete starter content (name, subtitle, description, modules, AI prompts, templates, and checklists) so the app ships with ready-to-generate products on first launch.

Update the generated master bundle README content to remove the hard-coded “Automation Products Bundle” naming and instead describe a neutral multi-product digital bundle that matches the three default themes (planner, templates, wall art) while keeping all user-facing text in English.
Eliminate reliance on CDN-loaded global scripts for jsPDF and JSZip by bundling them via the frontend build system, so the app builds and deploys reliably without external runtime dependencies.
Ensure the project builds and deploys successfully after the dependency change, with clear user-facing error handling if PDF or ZIP generation fails at runtime (English only).

Update the app’s default three products so they match the previously selected themes (Digital Planner, Canva Templates, Printable Wall Art) and ensure each default product is prefilled with complete starter content (name, subtitle, description, modules/chapters, AI prompts, templates, and checklists) so users can generate all three fully built products immediately on first launch.

Prevent existing local drafts from unintentionally overriding the updated default products by bumping the local draft storage version/key and providing a safe fallback behavior (e.g., treat older draft versions as incompatible and start from the new defaults).
